Contemporary producers and sample libraries use the name across both relaxed, jazzy textures and darker, more forceful arrangements, within the wider circulation of phonk online.

Vintage Chanson is the actual historical popular-song discovery field spanning humorous, sentimental and theatrical recordings, not a newly exclusive musical language or an assertion that older chanson was absent. Modern chanson pop and French pop remain broader later popular fields; their full scope does not prohibit heritage repertoire. No alias is inferred solely from overlap.
